infoPlist.NSUserNotificationUsageDescription: We use notifications to remind you to follow up with your leads.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Use Face ID to sign in faster and unlock the app on this device.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Your microphone is used to record voice notes on leads, such as spoken updates instead of typing.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Your contacts are used only when you choose to save a lead to your phone's address book.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Your photo library is used when you choose a profile picture or add photos to a Quick Lead.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Your camera is used when you take a profile picture or photos for a Quick Lead.
